questions.question: How many of the tickets got their summary from the small-1 model, without falling back to large-1?

What are the ids of the tickets whose summary came from the large-1 model, in the order they were processed?
questions.format: A JSON list of the ticket ids exactly as they appear in tickets.json, e.g. [3, 7]; [] if none

questions.question: What was the length, in characters, of the longest prompt (instruction plus ticket text) that app.py sent in this run?

questions.question: What was the size, in bytes, of the summaries.json file that this run wrote?
